title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.
Role Description
We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.
Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.
Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands
- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market
- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements
- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting
- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction
- Meeting and exceeding sales targets
- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets
Qualifications
- Proven track record of successful B2 B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries
- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers
- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements
- Fluent in English and Portuguese
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field
- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools
- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Salesforce business system analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)
Location: LATAM
Duration: 6-12months
Job Summary:
We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.
Key Responsibilities:
·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.
·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows .
·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.
·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards .
·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.
·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.
·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation .
·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.
·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams .
·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization .
Required Qualifications:
·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure .
·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud .
·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management .
·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies .
·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .
·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .
·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: English teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:
Job Title: Salesforce Administrator
Location: Remote (LATAM)
Duration: 6months
Role Overview
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable solutions while ensuring data integrity, automation efficiency, and user adoption.
Key Responsibilities Administer and maintain the Salesforce platform including user setup, profiles, roles, and permissions Design and implement custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, and flows Build and manage reports and dashboards for business insights Automate business processes using Flow, Process Builder (legacy), and approval processes Perform data management including imports, deduplication, and data quality monitoring Support Sales, Service, and other cloud users with issue resolution and enhancements Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and translate business requirements
Ensure system security, compliance, and best practices
Manage releases, change sets, and deployments
Provide user training and drive Salesforce adoption
Required Skills & Qualifications
4–7 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator
Strong expertise in:
Salesforce configuration (Objects, Fields, Layouts)
Flow Builder (must-have) Reports & Dashboards
Data Loader / Data Import Wizard
Understanding of Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud Knowledge of security model (Profiles, Roles, Sharing Rules) Experience with data quality and governance Familiarity with integration concepts (REST/SOAP APIs – basic level) Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment

Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.

5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role.
Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front).
Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions.
Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services.
Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer).
Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Partner success manager
description:
Sobre a vaga
O(a) Partner Success Manager atuará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e organizações parceiras de serviços para assegurar resultados de alta qualidade. Trata-se de uma excelente oportunidade para ajudar a definir e expandir uma função que impacta diretamente o desempenho das entregas, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve a capacidade de longo prazo dos parceiros.
Principais responsabilidades
• Garantir que os parceiros entreguem valor mensurável e dentro do prazo aos clientes, tanto na implementação quanto ao longo da jornada do cliente.

• Mais de 2 anos de experiência em suporte à entrega, operações com parceiros, customer success, coordenação de projetos ou áreas correlatas.
• Forte organização e atenção aos detalhes.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.
• Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes multifuncionais.
Desejáveis
• Experiência com ferramentas de acompanhamento de projetos ou tickets (ex.: Jira, Service Now, Zendesk).
• Vivência com programas de ecossistema de parceiros ou governança de entregas.
• Proficiência em idiomas conforme a região (ver variações regionais).

title: P&c insurance claims expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.
Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil
POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:
As a P& C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our
customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes
through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.
Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of Saa S solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.
This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.

DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Customer Relationship Management Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted
advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on
expectations and needs.
Proactive Engagement Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning
sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose
proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.
Performance Monitoring Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the
product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and
intervene early when needed.
Product Enhancements Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product
development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the
customer.
Renewals and Upselling Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.
Customer Training Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.
Internal Collaboration Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.
JOB SKILLS:
Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global
environment.
Must Haves: Insurance Expertise Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value
Language Skills
This role requires tri-lingual language skills: Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.
Nice to Haves: Customer Focus and Engagement You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand
their needs and exceed their expectations.
Business & Analytical Insights You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business
objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling
and analytical insights.
Technical Proficiency You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant Saa S tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Ai quality analyst (portuguese)
description:
Company Description
Million Logics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, Million Logics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, Million Logics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Offer Details:
Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home)
Contract Duration: 12 months
Number of Open Positions: 20
Key Qualifications
Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required.  We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.
Description:
In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying \" Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.
Education & Experience
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

title: Partner success manager
description:
Sobre a vaga
O(a) Partner Success Manager atuará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e organizações parceiras de serviços para assegurar resultados de alta qualidade. Trata-se de uma excelente oportunidade para ajudar a definir e expandir uma função que impacta diretamente o desempenho das entregas, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve a capacidade de longo prazo dos parceiros.
Principais responsabilidades
• Garantir que os parceiros entreguem valor mensurável e dentro do prazo aos clientes, tanto na implementação quanto ao longo da jornada do cliente.
• Manter visibilidade sobre o progresso das implementações dos parceiros, atuando de forma transversal para acelerar entregas e assegurar o cumprimento de marcos.
• Identificar riscos de forma proativa, reduzir fricções e gerenciar escalonamentos, facilitando planos de recuperação (“path to green”) e engajando as partes envolvidas para resolução de problemas.
• Garantir que os escalonamentos sejam monitorados, tratados com urgência e reportados de forma adequada.
• Colaborar com a área de Enablement para avaliar a prontidão e o alinhamento dos parceiros.
• Impulsionar o desenvolvimento de capacidades dos parceiros por meio de atividades estruturadas de capacitação e oportunidades de shadowing.
• Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Delivery, Suporte, Produto e Cloud para otimizar o suporte às implementações.
• Capturar e reportar resultados de entrega, tendências de escalonamento e indicadores de prontidão.
• Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de playbooks, procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) e frameworks de sucesso de parceiros.
Qualificações essenciais
• Mais de 2 anos de experiência em suporte à entrega, operações com parceiros, customer success, coordenação de projetos ou áreas correlatas.
• Forte organização e atenção aos detalhes.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.
• Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes multifuncionais.
Desejáveis
• Experiência com ferramentas de acompanhamento de projetos ou tickets (ex.: Jira, Service Now, Zendesk).
• Vivência com programas de ecossistema de parceiros ou governança de entregas.
• Proficiência em idiomas conforme a região (ver variações regionais).

title: Software engineer iii
description:
Top 3 habilidades técnicas obrigatórias: Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e microsserviços, frameworks Java Script e banco de dados SQL/Postgres
Visão geral da posição
Como Engenheiro(a) de Software Principal na equipe de Administração de Membros dentro das soluções de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção da Autodesk, você será responsável por orientar a equipe de engenharia e liderar o design técnico para construir funcionalidades que preparem nossos clientes para o sucesso no Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
A equipe de Administração de Membros é responsável por fornecer aos clientes do ACC ferramentas para gerenciar usuários e permissões de hubs e projetos. Trabalhamos diretamente com nossos clientes para oferecer soluções para alguns de seus maiores desafios em gestão de construção. Você desempenhará um papel crítico em transformar essas soluções em realidade.
O ACC melhora a gestão da construção e capacita todos os construtores com equipes conectadas, fluxos de trabalho e dados por meio de uma plataforma onde os usuários podem interagir de forma fluida e eficiente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida da construção. Nosso objetivo é economizar tempo eliminando redundâncias e oferecendo uma única plataforma que equipes inteiras podem usar para compartilhar informações de forma eficaz. Estamos construindo o futuro do software de construção.
Responsabilidades
Projetar, codificar, testar, depurar e documentar novas e existentes funcionalidades para garantir que a aplicação atenda às necessidades de negócio, qualidade e operação
Construir código robusto e de alta qualidade e estabelecer/manter altos padrões de qualidade e testes
Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software
Interpretar e traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e tarefas
Aplicar habilidades de resolução de problemas técnicos para projetar soluções de arquitetura seguras e escaláveis
Pesquisar e impulsionar a adoção de novas tecnologias
Identificar riscos e propor estratégias de mitigação relacionadas à arquitetura da aplicação
Participar ativamente de revisões de código e pull requests
Colaborar com diversas equipes dentro da ACS, tanto locais quanto internacionais
Atender, em regime de rodízio, incidentes críticos fora do horário comercial ou nos fins de semana para garantir disponibilidade 24/7 da plataforma
Qualificações mínimas
Mais de 8 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias web
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em produção com aplicações em infraestrutura de nuvem em larga escala
Experiência avançada na construção de APIs RESTful, microsserviços e interfaces front-end
Experiência avançada com frameworks Java Script (Node.js, React)
Experiência avançada com SQL/Postgres
Forte conhecimento em AWS e arquiteturas em nuvem
Experiência sólida com ferramentas de manutenção e monitoramento de aplicações
Experiência sólida na criação de automações e pipelines de CI/CD
Experiência liderando uma equipe de pelo menos 3 engenheiros de software
Familiaridade com Docker para criação de aplicações containerizadas
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de se comunicar com diferentes públicos, incluindo gerentes de produto, clientes e engenheiros de software
Curiosidade para entender e analisar problemas, pensar criticamente e propor soluções
Habilidade de colaboração remota em equipes distribuídas
Flexibilidade diante de mudanças e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos
Paixão por crescimento, aprendizado e mentoria
Software de gestão de construção que serve como sua única fonte de verdade para cada projeto.
Saiba como o Autodesk Construction Cloud pode ajudar suas equipes a colaborar com segurança e rapidez em todas as fases do projeto, permitindo entregas dentro do prazo e do orçamento.

title: Ai solutions lead
description:
Sobre a Hexa
A Hexa nasce com a ambição de se tornar uma das principais referências em inteligência artificial no Brasil. Atuamos na construção de soluções aplicadas que combinam estratégia, arquitetura, tecnologia e execução para gerar valor real aos clientes.
Nosso trabalho começa com entendimento profundo do contexto de cada empresa. Por meio do nosso Diagnóstico Vivo, analisamos cinco dimensões centrais — processos, dados, sistemas, resultados e governança — para identificar oportunidades e desenhar soluções integradas que façam sentido dentro do ecossistema do cliente.
Não buscamos criar iniciativas isoladas de IA. Nosso foco é estruturar soluções conectadas ao negócio, aos sistemas existentes e à operação, com visão de longo prazo, aplicabilidade prática e impacto mensurável.
A oportunidade
Estamos buscando uma pessoa para atuar como referência técnica em soluções de IA dentro da Hexa.
Essa pessoa terá papel relevante no desenho das soluções que levamos aos clientes, ajudando a transformar contexto de negócio em arquitetura, decisão técnica e implementação. Procuramos alguém com boa profundidade técnica, perfil hands-on e capacidade de participar ativamente da construção, validação e evolução das soluções na prática.
Mais do que alguém que domina ferramentas, queremos uma pessoa com bom julgamento técnico. Alguém que saiba avaliar quando usar LLMs, quando usar agentes, quando optar por automações mais determinísticas, quando aplicar técnicas tradicionais de machine learning e, principalmente, como integrar essas abordagens em soluções coerentes, sustentáveis e orientadas a valor.
Como a Hexa está em fase de construção, esta é uma posição para quem quer ter impacto real, proximidade com liderança e espaço para contribuir com a forma como a empresa desenha e entrega soluções de IA aplicada.
Responsabilidades
Participar do desenho técnico de soluções de IA para clientes, do diagnóstico à definição da arquitetura.
Atuar como referência técnica em IA aplicada dentro da Hexa, contribuindo com decisões técnicas de forma pragmática.
Traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções viáveis, integradas e orientadas a resultado.
Definir, junto ao time, a melhor abordagem para cada contexto, incluindo LLMs, agentes, workflows, automação, ML clássico, visão computacional ou combinações dessas frentes.
Apoiar processos de discovery, pré-venda e desenho de propostas técnicas.
Contribuir para padrões de desenvolvimento, validação, avaliação, observabilidade, segurança e evolução das soluções.
Trabalhar na construção de soluções agênticas e ecossistemas integrados aos dados, sistemas e processos dos clientes.
Apoiar a criação de playbooks, repertório técnico e boas práticas internas.
Contribuir para a consolidação da proposta de valor e do posicionamento técnico da Hexa no mercado.
O que buscamos
Experiência real com arquitetura e entrega de soluções de IA em produção.
Base sólida em arquitetura de software, integrações, APIs e desenho de soluções.
Domínio prático de aplicações com LLMs.
Experiência com agentes, tool calling, workflows e orquestração de soluções de IA.
Entendimento de prompt engineering, context engineering, avaliação de qualidade, guardrails e observabilidade.
Boa capacidade de análise de negócio e de tradução entre contexto executivo e decisão técnica.
Conhecimento consistente de dados, estrutura de dados e fundamentos de machine learning.
Familiaridade com visão computacional será considerada um diferencial.
Curiosidade genuína sobre o ecossistema atual de IA, ferramentas emergentes e novas formas de construir soluções.
Autonomia, senso de dono, maturidade para priorizar e forte accountability.
Interesse em atuar em uma empresa pequena, em construção, com proximidade com liderança e clientes.
Perfil ideal
Procuramos uma pessoa que reúna três características ao mesmo tempo:
profundidade técnica para tomar boas decisões;
profundidade técnica para contribuir com boas decisões;
capacidade prática para construir e validar soluções;
maturidade para atuar com autonomia em um ambiente de alta responsabilidade. Não buscamos um perfil apenas acadêmico, nem alguém focado exclusivamente em pesquisa. Também não buscamos uma liderança distante da execução. Esta posição exige presença técnica real, boa comunicação, visão arquitetural e conforto para operar em contexto de ambiguidade e crescimento.
Diferenciais
Experiência anterior em consultoria, boutique de tecnologia, startup ou ambiente de construção.
Vivência com projetos B2 B complexos e integração com ambientes corporativos.
Experiência com soluções agênticas, agentes autônomos, multiagentes ou arquiteturas orientadas a ferramentas.
Familiaridade com ambientes cloud e decisões de arquitetura distribuída.
Capacidade de equilibrar profundidade técnica com pragmatismo de negócio e clareza executiva.
Modelo de contratação
Contratação no modelo PJ.
Posição com senioridade entre pleno e sênior, com expectativa de forte participação técnica e capacidade de execução.
Atuação em ambiente de alta autonomia, baixa burocracia e proximidade com decisões estratégicas.
O que a pessoa encontrará na Hexa
Espaço real para construir.
Proximidade com clientes, liderança e decisões estratégicas.
Ambiente de alta autonomia, baixa burocracia e forte senso de responsabilidade.
Oportunidade de participar da construção de uma empresa de IA desde seus fundamentos.
Contexto ideal para quem quer combinar profundidade técnica, impacto prático e crescimento acelerado.
Encerramento
Se você quer atuar em uma posição com impacto real, profundidade técnica e protagonismo na construção de soluções de IA aplicadas, a Hexa pode ser o lugar certo para você.
Buscamos alguém que queira ajudar a construir não apenas projetos, mas uma forma consistente, sofisticada e prática de aplicar inteligência artificial para transformar negócios.

title: Consultor técnico hcm orc (oracle recruiting cloud)
description:
Consultor Técnico HCM ORC (Oracle Recruiting Cloud)
Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
Idioma: Inglês fluente obrigatório
Visão Geral da Posição
Estamos em busca de um Consultor Técnico HCM ORC (Oracle Recruiting Cloud) com forte conhecimento técnico em Oracle HCM Cloud para integrar nosso time.
O profissional ideal deve possuir entre 5 e 8 anos de experiência, com perfil predominantemente técnico (80%) e funcional (20%), sendo responsável por desenvolver, manter e suportar soluções técnicas relacionadas ao Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) e demais módulos do Oracle HCM Cloud.
Além disso, é necessário inglês fluente, pois o profissional atuará em um ambiente internacional, com interação frequente com equipes globais.
Principais Responsabilidades
Desenvolver, configurar e manter soluções técnicas dentro do Oracle HCM Cloud, com foco em Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC).
Criar e manter HCM Extracts, responsáveis por integrações de entrada e saída de dados.
Desenvolver e manter relatórios utilizando BI Publisher.
Desenvolver e otimizar consultas utilizando SQL e PL/SQL.
Criar e manter Fast Formulas relacionadas aos módulos do HCM.
Atuar em atividades de conversão e migração de dados utilizando ferramentas Oracle.
Trabalhar em conjunto com times funcionais para entender requisitos de negócio e transformá-los em soluções técnicas.
Garantir boas práticas em integrações, relatórios e gestão de dados dentro do Oracle HCM.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
Conhecimentos Técnicos
Experiência com Oracle HCM Cloud, especialmente Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) – parte técnica.
Experiência com HCM Extracts (interfaces de integração de entrada e saída).
Experiência na criação de relatórios utilizando BI Publisher.
Conhecimento sólido em SQL e PL/SQL.
Experiência com Fast Formulas em módulos do HCM.
Experiência em Conversão de Dados
Experiência com ferramentas Oracle para migração e carga de dados:
HDL (HCM Data Loader)
PBL (Payroll Batch Loader)
Diferenciais (Desejável)
Experiência com Taleo Recruit
Experiência com Taleo Learn
Experiência com Oracle Payroll

description:
Descrição do Cargo
Experiência no setor de saúde é desejável, com bom entendimento de sistemas de saúde, operações clínicas, etc.
Mínimo de 8 a 10 anos de forte experiência trabalhando com Oracle Cloud Financials – módulos GL, FAH, EDMCS e AR.
Experiência em projetos de suporte e melhorias (enhancements).
Experiência em desenho e implementação de soluções de sistemas para processos financeiros principais, especialmente nas áreas de Records to Report (R2 R) e Order to Cash (O2 C) . Capacidade de liderar de forma independente o desenho e a transformação da estrutura empresarial, como mapeamento de COA (plano de contas), razão (ledger) e estrutura de unidades de negócio (BU) para empresas complexas.
Experiência no desenho de soluções para contabilidade regulatória, como FERC.
Forte habilidade na criação de modelos complexos de alocação para CAPEX, Receita e OPEX.
Forte experiência na configuração do Oracle Cloud GL e Accounting Hub para mapeamento de plano de contas (COA), incluindo o desenho de interfaces complexas com sistemas externos.

Forte conhecimento de ferramentas de integração como FBDI, Webservices e familiaridade com OIC, incluindo componentes Oracle Paa S.
Experiência na criação de documentos de design funcional para objetos RICE e na coordenação com equipes técnicas e funcionais durante design, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.
Responsável por gerenciar o desenho e a entrega ponta a ponta de objetos RICE de alto volume (Interfaces, Conversões, Extensões e Relatórios).

title: Crm manager / hubspot administrator
description:
Warmy.io is a revolutionary AI-powered email deliverability platform for ESPs and CRMs, helping companies ensure their emails land in the inbox — not the spam folder.
Our platform automates email warm-up using advanced AI, seed lists, and deliverability insights that improve domain and IP reputation. Warmy sends up to 10 M automated warm-up emails daily, integrates with tools like Google Postmaster Tools, and supports 30+ languages, enabling businesses to scale outreach globally with confidence.
Thousands of marketers, Saa S companies, and growth teams rely on Warmy to protect their sender reputation and maximize inbox placement.
We are a fully remote international team building powerful tools used by companies around the world.
About the Role
We are looking for a CRM Manager / Hub Spot Administrator who will take full ownership of our Hub Spot ecosystem and transform it into a powerful growth engine.
This role is perfect for someone who loves data, automation, clean systems, and turning complex workflows into simple, scalable processes.
You will work closely with sales, marketing, customer success, and leadership to ensure that our CRM is structured, automated, and delivering actionable insights that drive revenue growth.
If you enjoy optimizing systems, building automation, and creating clarity from data, this role will give you the opportunity to make a huge impact.
What You’ll Do
• Own and manage the Hub Spot CRM infrastructure across sales, marketing, and customer success
• Build and optimize CRM workflows, automations, and lifecycle processes
• Maintain excellent data hygiene and enforce CRM best practices across the organization
• Create and manage customer journeys, touchpoints, and automated communication flows
• Analyze CRM data to generate actionable insights that improve sales and marketing performance
• Build dashboards and reports that help leadership make data-driven decisions
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate data flow between systems
• Optimize lead segmentation, pipeline management, and attribution tracking
• Ensure compliance with data privacy and security standards
• Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency and automation across the CRM ecosystem
What We’re Looking For
• Deep experience working with Hub Spot CRM (administration, workflows, automation)
• Strong analytical mindset and ability to translate data into actionable insights
• Experience supporting sales and marketing teams through CRM systems
• Strong understanding of lead management, lifecycle stages, and segmentation
• Experience building automations, reporting dashboards, and CRM workflows
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to clean, structured data
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across teams
• Proactive problem solver who enjoys improving systems and processes
Nice to have
• Hub Spot certifications
• Experience in B2 B Saa S companies
• Experience integrating CRM with other tools (marketing automation, analytics, etc.)
Why Join Warmy.io
• Work with a global remote team across multiple countries
• Help build a leading AI-driven Saa S platform used by businesses worldwide
• Take ownership of systems that directly impact company growth and revenue
• High level of autonomy and responsibility
• Opportunity to grow with a rapidly scaling company
If you enjoy building clean systems, powerful automation, and data-driven growth, we would love to meet you.

title: Artificial intelligence engineer (games development)
description:
Role Summary
Build and own Naphora’s AI and LLM prompt infrastructure across the entire game development pipeline.
Your objective is to massively increase output, speed, and quality across all departments by orchestrating the right LLMs, tools, and prompt systems at scale.
This role sits at the intersection of production, creativity, and execution, acting as a force multiplier for the entire studio.
Responsibilities:
LLM Experimentation & Orchestration
Continuously test, benchmark, and integrate new LLMs
Select the right model per department and use case
Design and run multi-model pipelines to maximize output and diversity
Manage tradeoffs between cost, performance, and reliability
Game Design & Development Support
Build prompt systems for game design (mechanics, economies, progression, balancing, level concepts)
Support narrative, quests, world-building, dialogue, and item systems
Assist engineering with documentation, system design drafts, and technical breakdowns
Accelerate prototyping and pre-production cycles
Art, UX & Production
Generate concepts for characters, environments, UI text, UX flows, and feature descriptions
Support production with GDDs, specs, Jira stories, sprint planning, and retrospectives
Reduce documentation and coordination friction across teams
UA, Marketing & Live Ops
Scale creative ideation for ads, playables, and campaigns
Support Live Ops planning, offer design, and content calendars
Enable rapid iteration across markets, audiences, and formats
Prompt Systems & Enablement
Build reusable, modular prompt frameworks across departments
Create and maintain a shared internal prompt library and best practices
Train teams to use AI effectively without slowing production
Ensure outputs meet Naphora’s quality bar
What We Care About:
We care more about what you’ve built with AI than your title or background
Show us real work: projects, experiments, tools, workflows
Git Hub, portfolio, demos, or anything hands-on is strongly preferred
Qualifications:
Strong hands-on experience with multiple LLMs and AI tooling
Proven ability to increase output across complex, cross-functional teams
Solid understanding of the game development pipeline
Comfortable working with designers, engineers, artists, producers, and marketers
Builder mindset with high ownership and autonomy
Pragmatic and execution-focused

title: E-2 visa specialist
description:
Company Description
Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique law firm that guides global talent, investors, and founders through the U. S. immigration process so that they can build their future in the United States. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, the firm serves clients across the U. S. and globally, offering fully remote services. Robinson Immigration Law creates tailored immigration strategies based on each client’s long-term goals.
Role Description
This is a full-time remote role for an E-2 Visa Specialist. The Specialist will be responsible for guiding clients through the E-2 visa application process, including reviewing financial and business documentation, drafting strong submissions, and addressing any legal concerns in collaboration with attorneys. The role involves managing client communications, conducting case research, and maintaining compliance with immigration regulations to ensure successful application outcomes.
Qualifications

Strong knowledge of E-2 visa requirements and U. S. immigration law, with experience in investment and business-based immigration pathways.
Proficient in reviewing financial and business documents and preparing detailed and accurate visa application submissions.
Excellent written communication and document preparation skills, including drafting business plans and legal statements.
Strong client management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate with individuals from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds.
Attention to detail and ability to perform thorough legal research to ensure compliance and effective case documentation.
Bachelor’s degree or advanced education in law, business, or a related field is preferred.
Proficiency in remote collaboration tools and the ability to work autonomously in a remote environment.
The firm operates fully remotely, so candidates are invited to apply regardless of location.
We provide competitive compensation with performance incentives, a fully remote career opportunity, a collaborative work environment, and opportunities for growth and advancement.
We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Parceiro de negócios
description:

Buscamos profissionais que atuam com relacionamento com clientes, vendas consultivas ou originação de crédito, interessados em gerar novas oportunidades no mercado financeiro.

– Prospecção de clientes com necessidade de crédito
– Cadastro da proposta em sistema próprio
– Acompanhamento da operação com suporte especializado

✔ Comissionamento agressivo por operação aprovada
✔ Alto potencial de ganhos no mercado de crédito
✔ Possibilidade de renda recorrente
✔ Sem necessidade de estrutura própria

Perfil ideal:
– Corretores de imóveis
– Consultores financeiros
– Profissionais do mercado imobiliário
– Contadores e assessores financeiros
– Profissionais com carteira de clientes
⸻
Diferenciais da operação:
✔ Especialização em home equity
✔ Alta taxa de aprovação em crédito
✔ Processo estruturado e ágil
✔ Suporte completo (do cadastro ao fechamento)
✔ Atuação sólida no mercado financeiro

Como participar:
Se você busca parceria comercial no mercado financeiro ou deseja atuar com crédito com garantia de imóvel, entre em contato via mensagem privada.

title: Legal assistant
description:
Position Overview Gemean is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Legal Assistant to support our legal, forensic, and investigative teams. In this role, you will assist with case preparation, document management, and coordination across legal and investigative matters. You will work closely with attorneys, analysts, and project managers to ensure efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and timely communication. This position plays an important role in maintaining operational efficiency and supporting complex litigation, investigations, and regulatory matters.
Key Responsibilities
Assist legal teams with preparation and organization of case files, documentation, and supporting materials
Manage legal documents, correspondence, and records while maintaining accurate filing systems
Support document review processes and assist with organizing electronically stored information (ESI) for investigations and litigation
Coordinate with internal teams including e Discovery, forensic analysts, and project managers on case-related tasks
Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, and maintain calendars for legal professionals
Assist in drafting routine legal correspondence, reports, and administrative documentation
Track case progress, deadlines, and important milestones to ensure timely execution
Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive legal information with discretion
Required Qualifications and Skills
Proven experience as a legal assistant, paralegal support professional, or in a similar legal administrative role
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience supporting legal, compliance, forensic investigation, financial, or Web3-related matters involving case documentation and administrative coordination
Strong organizational and document management skills with high attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency in common office and document management software tools
Ability to handle sensitive legal, financial, and investigative information with discretion
Additional Preferred Qualifications and Skills
Experience supporting litigation, investigations, or compliance matters preferred
Familiarity with e Discovery processes and legal documentation workflows is advantageous
Knowledge of legal research methods and document review practices is beneficial
Exposure to forensic investigations or regulatory environments is a plus
About Gemean
Gemean is a global leader in forensic investigations, electronic discovery, and data analytics. We utilize advanced platforms like Pyth AI and cutting-edge data tools to interpret complex datasets, support legal cases, and fortify organizational compliance and governance. Our multidisciplinary approach enables us to deliver comprehensive, actionable insights tailored to our clients’ needs.

title: Ai quality analyst (portuguese)
description:
Company Description
Million Logics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, Million Logics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, Million Logics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.
Role Overview:
As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.
Offer Details:
Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home)
Contract Duration: 12 months
Number of Open Positions: 20
Key Qualifications
Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required.  We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.
Description:
In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
Extracting and verifying \" Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.
Education & Experience
BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
Offer Details:
Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
Engagement type: Contractor
Evaluation Process -
Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.

  • Promover reuniões periódicas de alinhamento com a coordenação médica para otimização dos processos;
  • Tomar decisões em conjunto com a coordenação médica, garantindo coerência e alinhamento estratégico;

  • Garantir que os profissionais estejam alinhados e cumpram as normas institucionais;
  • Incentivar e manter uma cultura de feedback contínuo dentro da equipe;
  • Acompanhar os KRs (Key Results), garantindo o cumprimento das metas;
  • Monitorar indicadores de qualidade e produtividade, especialmente dos médicos patologistas;
  • Planejar, conduzir treinamentos e capacitar a equipe operacional para desenvolvimento contínuo.
  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Biologia, Biomedicina, Administração, Gestão Hospitalar;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Gestão em Saúde, Gestão Hospitalar, Qualidade ou Processos será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia em supervisão, coordenação ou liderança de equipes, preferencialmente em laboratório de patologia/anatomia patológica e diagnóstico por laboratório;
  • Conhecimento dos processos de anatomia patológica e/ou patologia clínica.

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

title: Supervisor De Manutenção Elétrica
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades: Supervisionar tecnicamente a execução das manutenções corretivas, preventivas e preditivas em sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos. Garantir o cumprimento do plano de manutenção e dos apontamentos no sistema ERP. Participar do planejamento semanal e validar as ordens de serviço com base na criticidade, recursos e prioridade. Acompanhar e apoiar tecnicamente as atividades complexas da área durante a rotina e paradas de máquina. Supervisionar a aplicação de normas técnicas, procedimentos de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade. Coordenar a elaboração e atualização da matriz de criticidade dos equipamentos. Participar ativamente das reuniões diárias (daily management), discutindo desvios e planos de ação. Propor e acompanhar projetos de melhorias, upgrades de sistemas e redução de custos. Contribuir com auditorias internas e externas, garantindo o alinhamento técnico da área. Desenvolver tecnicamente os profissionais da equipe, promovendo conhecimento e engajamento. Apoiar o Coordenador de Manutenção nas definições estratégicas e gestão de recursos. Realizar interface com outras áreas para alinhamento técnico e definição de prioridades. Validar escopos de manutenção sob demanda, materiais e serviços de terceiros. Administrar a equipe de trabalho, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho de alta motivação, energia e cooperação, orientando, treinando, acompanhando a atuação, avaliando o desempenho, dando feedback, divulgando, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir os procedimentos/normas relativos à empresa, processo de trabalho e aos sistemas de gestão implementados;
Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino Técnico Completo em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas. Desejável ensino superior cursando em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas. Experiência em Manutenção Industrial. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Domínio em Interpretação e atualização de diagramas elétricos e eletrônicos. Conhecimento em comandos elétricos e motores, em Subestações (13,8 e 69 kV) e em Ferramentas e equipamentos de medição elétrica. Domínio Multiplicador em Manutenção elétrica e eletrônica. Domínio Multiplicador em Interpretação e atualização de diagramas elétricos e eletrônicos. Domínio em Matriz de criticidade e gestão de ativos. Conhecimento em Sistema ERP (ex: SAP). Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Líder Técnico Iii (React Native/Nodejs)
description:
Descrição da vagaO Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar com liderança técnica de projetos de software, no Inatel Competence Center - ICC.Responsabilidades e atribuições- Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software;
- Atuar na definição desoluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade, segurança, disponibilidade e desempenho;

- Realizar especificaçãofuncional e técnica de sistemas e aplicações;
- Prover soluções e suporte ao desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicativos móveis e web;
- Desenvolver aplicaçõesde alto nível de complexidade técnica;
- Atuar em conjunto como time de QA, apoiando estratégias de testes e qualidade;
- Revisar códigos-fonte,garantindo aderência a boas práticas, padrões de projeto e qualidade de software;
- Projetar soluções comfoco em integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
- Atuar como referênciatécnica, promovendo capacitação, mentoria e suporte aos desenvolvedores;
- Planejar, acompanhar emonitorar as atividades técnicas dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade;
- Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à evolução do projeto, arquitetura e infraestrutura.Requisitos e qualificaçõesEnsino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia, tais como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de projetos de software;
Desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando React Native, Expo e Node.Js;
Vivência com:- Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares);
- Atuação em ambientes com cultura DevOps.- Desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis e aplicações web;
- Design e definição dearquitetura de aplicações móveis e backend;
- Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
- Desenvolvimento e consumo de Web Services e APIs REST;
- Aplicação de Design Patterns e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
- Modelagem e documentação de projetos;
- Ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex.: Git) e análise de qualidade de código;
Atuação prévia com AWS (Amazon Web Services), incluindo:- Conceitos de arquitetura em nuvem;
- Uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway e CloudWatch;
- Boas práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade;
- Apoio à definição de pipelines e ambientes em nuvem.Forte atuação com:- Comunicação Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE);
- Comunicação em rede CAN;
- Publicação e distribuição de aplicativos nas lojas Apple App Store e Google Play;
- Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para build, testes e deploy;
- Testes automatizados;
- Ferramentas e conceitos de UX/UI Design.Informações adicionaisHorário de Trabalho: de segunda à sexta-feira das 08h00 às 12h00 e das 13h30 às 17h30.Local de Trabalho: as atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho "Home Office".
